prompt: Some webhook events that older clients still send are no longer routed. Investigate the compatibility files and restore the expected routing.

files.docs/compatibility.md: Older clients may send payment.completed. It is an alias for payment_succeeded and must reach billing. Unknown event names remain unrouted.

acceptance:
from router import route

def test_legacy_and_unknown_events():
    assert route("payment.completed") == "billing"
    assert route("payment_succeeded") == "billing"
    assert route("unknown") is None
